as_told.title: Farmington Armada witness: too many to count

plain: In 1950, half the town of Farmington, New Mexico, is said to have watched hundreds of silver discs swarm across the sky, an event later called the Farmington Armada. Michels tells the story on an episode filmed nearby. A witness he does not name gives a firsthand version on the same episode: "The first day there were a few. The second day there were too many to count." If true, it would be one of the largest mass sightings on record, seen by a whole town over more than one day.
